OpenSEO
Open-source Ahrefs and SEMrush alternative you can self-host
OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Ahrefs and SEMrush. It is MIT licensed, self-hostable with one Docker command, and has no subscription. You pay per lookup instead of per month, and your data stays on your own infrastructure.
It includes 17 tools: 6 keyword tools (overview, ideas, difficulty, SERP checker), 8 website and backlink tools (domain overview, page analyser, backlink profiles, competitor analysis), and 3 AI and local tools. Site audits run 117 technical checks across up to 500 pages. Local rank grids range from 3x3 to 7x7. OpenSEO also tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity cite your site, measured across 120+ AI models.

SilverSafe AI
The trusted voice older adults call before they get scammed
SAM is an AI phone and text companion for older adults. If you get a suspicious call, text, or email, hang up and then call or text 844-8-ASK-SAM like you'd call a trusted friend. SAM asks the right questions, flags warning signs, and tells you what to do next. Caregivers get a call or text when something looks off and can see past checks in the family dashboard. SAM checks links and images, including whether a photo is AI generated, helps document scams, and guides you to the right place to report them. No app needed, and it works with the phone you already have. Spanish and Canada support coming soon.
Call or text 844-8-ASK-SAM to start free with 2 checks, no card required

Screenlint
Automated UI/UX audits for iPhone apps including iPhone Duo
Screenlint checks your iPhone app’s UI/UX without needing source code. Upload a zipped simulator build (React Native, SwiftUI/UIKit, or Flutter). It runs the app on iOS simulators and checks screens in light and dark mode, at large text sizes, on iPhone Duo (folded and unfolded), and reads the accessibility tree.
You get a report engineers can act on with screenshots, issue locations, and severity from critical to polish. An optional recommendations tier explains how to fix each issue. It catches broken layouts, clipped text, controls under the crease, missing VoiceOver labels, and dark-mode contrast issues. Screenlint is in early access. Request access for a private upload link by email.
